Important clarifications about costs and registration

We know that in previous editions the payment process was different, but this year Furry Moonfest takes a step forward. With the goal of professionalizing the event and aligning ourselves with the reservation and registration methodology used in other conventions around the world, we have separated the accommodation and registration processes. So here we explain again how the process works:

Step 1: Hotel Reservation. It is independent of event registration. The room cost is split among those sharing it and includes breakfast and use of the hotel facilities.

Step 2: Event Ticket. Once you have your spot in a room with a confirmed reservation, you can purchase your ticket through the website once registrations open. This ticket costs 300,000 pesos (around 80 dollars) and includes:

· Official merch package.
· Access to all parties, panels, and the artist market.
· Round-trip transportation from Bogotá.
· And many more surprises!

If you have any questions about this topic, don't hesitate to write to us.

You can now visit our official website!

There you will find all the event information, you can reserve your room, and soon you will be able to buy your ticket for Furry Moonfest 2026.

👉 https://moonfest.furrycolombia.com/

Want to connect with other attendees?

Join our official Telegram group to find a roomie, sign up for activities, and chat with the community.

👉 https://t.me/FurryMoonfest

🎨: Nell Demon

Rules:

1. This is an SFW group—please do not post suggestive content.

2. No drama, no politics, no harassment; please be respectful of all attendees.

3. This group includes people who speak Spanish or English; please be respectful and understanding of those who do not speak the language.

4. If you have any questions, issues, or requests regarding the event or the group, please send a DM to the admins: Howl, Lucia, Nacho, Nax, and Nell.

This channel will be used to share all information related to Furry Moonfest.

Any message that does not correspond to this topic will be immediately deleted.
